description: The only tool that searches for a named owner. Fills a person or company name into that county's verified owner/taxpayer field as UPPER(field) LIKE UPPER('%NAME%'), a case-insensitive partial match, and returns a URL you can fetch or open in a browser. On a shared statewide or regional layer the county's scope predicate is ANDed in front, as (scope) AND UPPER(field) LIKE …, so only that county's rows come back. Where the layer carries the county's own confidential-owner flag (Texas Tax Code §25.025), flagged rows are excluded in the query, a row with no flag recorded counts as flagged, and the flag column is returned with each row. get_parcel_endpoint returns the endpoint and a generic sample query, not a name search, so come here for the name. This server does not execute the query and returns no parcel records: fetch the returned URL yourself. An endpoint is refused, with the reason, when a reviewed record says the county publishes no owner name or that owner names are withheld, when the layer serves no attribute search (query it by location instead), when its owner column is not searchable by name (use a parcel-id or location query instead), or when the layer's confidential-owner flag is present but incomplete, so no exclusion can be built.

owner_name.description: Owner/taxpayer name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive)

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g. 'IL') or full state name

name: build_owner_query
title: Build an owner-name search URL for one county
